sam (PM): final GA checklist sprint 1 min: we need explicit confirmation for SLA language, alerting, runbook owners, billing fallback, and a short customer comms pack. keep it terse.
izzy (SRE): SLOs proposed: p95 <= 150ms, p99 <= 400ms, uptime >= 99.95%. add an "error budget exhausted" play: 1) switch to quantized fallback, 2) throttle non-critical routes, 3) notify sales and customer.
omar (ProdOps): I'll run a 1-hour failover sim tomorrow 07:00 PT (reserved pool preemption + region spill). will attach traces and latency delta.
yuna (Docs): I'll write a 1-page "GA operations" doc + customer-ready SLA summary. need the exact rollback criteria to include.
felix (FinOps): two quick billing backstops: (A) burst credits (auto-surge fee 1.4x), (B) soft-throttle discount. drafting wording for pilot contracts; will include sample invoice message.
maya (Support): support request: canned incident emails, severity mapping, and a troubleshooting checklist for latency vs quality issues. want owners for each playbook.
sam (PM): owners: SRE -> izzy (alerts + synthetic), ProdOps -> omar (failover test + capacity plan), Docs -> yuna (doc + SLA wording), FinOps -> felix (pricing options), Support -> maya (runbooks + dry-run). target: EOD tomorrow.
izzy (SRE): alert rules I'll add: `p95 > 150ms for 5m`, `p99 > 400ms for 5m`, `burn_rate > 2 for 1h`. will also create a nightly synthetic that mixes 50/50 short/long sequences for 72h.
omar (ProdOps): scheduling the sim and will include a quick how-to in the runbook so oncall can reproduce.
yuna (Docs): will include "SLA exception flow" with template emails, contract snippet, and a short checklist for legal review.
felix (FinOps): adding auto-throttle clause: sustained >3x baseline for 15m triggers throttle unless enrolled in burst credits. will upload a tiny spreadsheet with sensitivity cases.
maya (Support): planning a 30m dry-run with oncall next week; will circulate calendar and test canned comms.
deploy-bot: Notice: prod-serving/v1.9 deployed to us-west-2 at 2024-07-10T14:01Z.
sam (PM): thanks all. reconvene tomorrow 09:30 PT for final sign-off. please keep updates to PRs and attach artifacts. :thumbsup:
